points.name: Aurora Main Stage
points.description: The main stage for headliners, from 20:00 until 02:00. Big screen and light show; the field in front fills up early.

points.name: The Hollow Tent
points.description: Striped circus tent for electronic sets and late-night shows. Gets busy after midnight.

points.name: Ember Pizza Truck
points.description: Pizza by the slice until 03:00, from the truck next to the picnic tables.

points.name: Night Market Picnic Area
points.description: Picnic tables next to the food truck, with vegan and gluten-free options. Free water refills.

points.name: Lakeside Bar
points.description: A quieter bar on the wooden deck over the pond, with low-alcohol and alcohol-free drinks.

points.name: Toilets
points.description: Portable toilets with one accessible cabin, between the pond and the main gate.

points.name: Medical Tent
points.description: Paramedics on site around the clock, in the tent with the red cross. Free earplugs, sunscreen and water too.

points.name: Main Gate
points.description: Main entrance and exit with bag checks. Shuttle buses stop just outside.

points.name: Campsite
points.description: Follow the lit path east to the campsite. You need a wristband with camping access.

points.name: Merch Tent
points.description: Official T-shirts, posters and tote bags, in the sand-colored tent by the lit path. Card payment only.
